Politics · India

DMK MLA Arrested; Party Debates Delimitation Bill Support

Tamil Nadu police arrested DMK MLA V. Senthil Balaji on Tuesday for making alleged derogatory remarks against Chief Minister M.K. Stalin. The arrest has drawn condemnation from DMK leaders, who accuse the state government of targeting party members. Meanwhile, the DMK is reportedly considering its stance on the Delimitation Bill, with party officials stating their support would depend on addressing concerns about southern states and the formula for women's reservation.
